name: freax-agent-skills
description: Public Claude Code plugin marketplace by freaxnx01 — sharable, non-personal skills.

plugins.name: sync-ai-instructions
plugins.description: Initialize or update a project's AI agent instruction files (CLAUDE.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md, SKILL.md, .ai/*) by pulling base + one stack overlay from github.com/freaxnx01/ai-instructions. Idempotent — works for first-time setup and re-runs to keep files in sync.

plugins.name: propose-ai-instructions
plugins.description: Reverse of sync-ai-instructions. Scans the current project for stack-specific conventions (v1: justfile recipes for the dotnet stack), classifies each as generic-enough-to-promote vs. project-specific, and writes a reviewable proposal patch for github.com/freaxnx01/ai-instructions. Never commits or pushes upstream — output is a proposal file the user reviews and lands manually.

plugins.name: release-notes
plugins.description: Generate user-friendly RELEASENOTES.md entries for missing versions from git tags, grouped by theme (New Features / Improvements / Bug Fixes). The end-user companion to CHANGELOG.md; append-only, never modifies existing entries.

plugins.name: hermes-tweet
plugins.description: Guide Claude Code users operating Hermes Agent through read-first X/Twitter research and approval-gated actions with Hermes Tweet.
